Reference / runtime/base64

runtime/base64#

The native layer under encoding/base64: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/base64: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable strict RFC 4648 Base64 boundary for encoding/base64.

Public API#

native base64_encode#

native base64_encode(origin is @byte, alphabet is string) is string

origin in Base64 with alphabet (standard or URL-safe).

native base64_invalid_offset#

native base64_invalid_offset(origin is string, alphabet is string) is int

Where origin stops being Base64 in alphabet, or -1.

native base64_decode#

native base64_decode(origin is string, alphabet is string) is @byte

The bytes of Base64 origin.
